name: kurt
description: kurt monorepo — kurt-agent (engine) + kurt-tui (Ink front-end) + kurt-app (Tauri desktop). Workspace root.
comment:workspaces: kurt-app is a standalone Tauri/Vite app with its own deps + bun.lock — intentionally NOT a workspace member (avoids hoisting React/Vite into the engine lockfile). It talks to kurt-bridge over HTTP, not via a TS workspace dep.
